audit_1.interpretation: These are exact population balances, not centred div(u). Local density changes and instantaneous fluid-wall exchange are allowed by full-way BounceBack numerical storage. Passing conservation does not establish concentration boundedness or transport accuracy. Negative individual populations are a diagnostic, not by themselves an acceptance criterion.

uniform_stencil.interpretation: A read-only exact first-order-equilibrium streaming stencil. This predicts the first step of an initially uniform scalar, not the evolved long-time scalar flux and not the carrier's population flux. A nonzero value demonstrates that exported cell velocities are not exactly divergence-free under this scalar equilibrium stencil.
